original_scene_designs.name: AURORA FLUX
original_scene_designs.visual_intent: Organic fluid flow field with domain-warped FBM noise — bass-driven domain scale creates slow breathing blobs, mids add curl turbulence, treble adds high-frequency shimmer

audio_mapping.bass: Domain scale (1.5-2.7) — larger, slower blobs on heavy bass
audio_mapping.mids: Warp amplitude (0.6-1.6) — more turbulence/curl on mids
audio_mapping.beat_pulse: White flash (0.45*pulse) — transient accent on kick

original_scene_designs.agsl_technique_outline: 4-octave FBM noise with audio-driven domain warping; coord = uv * bassScale + warp(w) * midWarp; treble adds high-freq noise2(coord*8); color navy->teal->magenta
original_scene_designs.uniform_usage: iAudioBass, iAudioMids, iAudioTreble, iAudioEnergy, iBeatPulse, iSceneTransition, iIntensity, iAspect, iTime, iTimeDelta, iResolution, iMouse
original_scene_designs.performance_estimate: ~8ms on MT6835 (2D FBM, no raymarch, 4 octaves)
original_scene_designs.low_end_fallback: Disable 2 FBM octaves (2 octaves instead of 4) on BATTERY tier
original_scene_designs.originality_note: Domain-warped FBM flow with bass-driven scale not in VVavy; organic fluid breathing feel novel

original_scene_designs.name: LIQUID CHROME
original_scene_designs.visual_intent: Navier-Stokes-inspired curl noise field with dynamic Monet palette — liquid metal surface with horizon glow, bass-driven dilation, mids-driven curl turbulence, treble specular highlights

audio_mapping.bass: Camera z-advance speed (1.5-4.0) + hill amplitude (0.08-0.23) — faster advance, taller hills
audio_mapping.mids: Curl noise amplitude + grid line width (0.03-0.05) — more turbulence, thicker lines
audio_mapping.treble: Grid intersection sparkle (1.4*treble) — sharp neon accents on intersections
audio_mapping.beat_pulse: Camera speed boost (1.5x) + horizon flash — transient camera kick

original_scene_designs.agsl_technique_outline: Curl noise via dFdx/dFdy of noise; perspective grid with audio-reactive hills; Monet palette blend; treble intersection sparkle
original_scene_designs.uniform_usage: iAudioBass, iAudioMids, iAudioTreble, iAudioEnergy, iBeatPulse, iSceneTransition, iIntensity, iAspect, iTime, iTimeDelta, iResolution, iMouse
original_scene_designs.performance_estimate: ~10ms on MT6835 (curl noise + grid, no raymarch)
original_scene_designs.low_end_fallback: Disable specular intersection pass on BATTERY tier
original_scene_designs.originality_note: Curl-noise liquid chrome with Monet palette novel; Navier-Stokes-inspired not in VVavy

original_scene_designs.name: NEBULA BLOOM
original_scene_designs.visual_intent: Concentric halo rings with harmonic orbital rays — central pulsing core, bass-driven ring density, mids-controlled ring count, treble ray sparkle, beat-triggered ring flash

audio_mapping.bass: Core radius (0.35-0.60) + ring speed (0.6-1.1) — larger core, faster ring expansion
audio_mapping.mids: Ring density/multiplier — more concentric rings on mids
audio_mapping.treble: Orbital ray sparkle (0.3-1.0) — harmonic rays on high frequencies
audio_mapping.energy: Global contrast/bloom multiplier — overall nebula brightness
audio_mapping.beat_pulse: Ring phase kick + core flash — transient ring expansion flash

original_scene_designs.agsl_technique_outline: Radial SDF: core ring + concentric shockwaves (fract(dist*2.5 - time)) + harmonic rays (sin(angle*8)); color mix teal->magenta; pow(0.9) contrast
original_scene_designs.uniform_usage: iAudioBass, iAudioMids, iAudioTreble, iAudioEnergy, iBeatPulse, iSceneTransition, iIntensity, iAspect, iTime, iTimeDelta, iResolution, iMouse
original_scene_designs.low_end_fallback: Disable ray pass (keep core + rings only) on BATTERY tier
original_scene_designs.originality_note: Harmonic orbital rays with audio-reactive ring phase novel; nebula bloom with harmonic rays not in VVavy
